item.title: Rallying Cry – November 11, 2026
item.description: Scientists made a breakthrough in curing deadly childhood brain tumors, Nigeria waived N24 billion in taxes to boost local drug production, Pakistan’s women’s cricket captain called for gender equality, and a new vaccine promises to revolutionize Lyme disease prevention.
